subject: renderPlot() error ... I think I'm missing something very simple

messages.author: 207205de2f4712d1
messages.subject: renderPlot() error ... I think I'm missing something very simple
parts:
Hi. I dove in with shiny late last year and a lot has changed since then. I am using the updated renderPlot() (rather than reactivePlot) function, but get the error:

> runApp()

Listening on port 8100
Error in serverFunc(input = .createReactiveValues(shinyapp$session, readonly = TRUE),  : 
  could not find function "renderPlot"


I am porting some standalone code that generates plot using ggplot2. The code works (it produces the plot successfully) when I run it as I wrote it outside of this shiny setup, but I get the above error when I run it in the shiny framework. My code is below - the functions I use are stored in a global.R file, which loads when runApp() is called (I think). I can only figure that the 'renderPlot' is not not loaded in the workspace (i.e., the 'shiny' library is not loaded), but I load 'shiny' in each of the server.R and ui.R files.

tldr; I don't know why R can't find the 'renderPlot' function (???)


"server.R":

library(shiny)

library(ggplot2)

library(twitteR)

library(RColorBrewer)

# Define server logic required to plot variables against mpg

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

  # create a donut plot to be published to the shinyUI mainPanel()

  output$main_calorie_plot <- renderPlot({

    # run a funciton that collects tweets

    twitteR_df <- get_twitteR_df(input$Username)

    # turn the tweets into long-form data

    tweet_data <- get_tweet_data(twitteR_df)

    # subset the long-form tweet data

    range_data <- get_range_data(tweet_data, day = 0, span = 1)

    # process the range data into a form for get_main_calorie_plot(), which then uses ggplot2 to generate a donut plot

    graph_data <- get_graph_data(range_data, as.cals = F)

    # ... a function that uses ggplot2 to generate a donut plot

    donut_plot <- get_main_calorie_plot(range_data)

    ##### I believe this is how others are returning ggplot2 output, to be displayed in the shinyUI - ???

    print(donut_plot)

    #####

  })

})


"ui.R":

library(shiny)

# Define UI for Nutwition application

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  # Applicaiton title

  headerPanel('Nutwition'),

  sidebarPanel(

    # create a text input box, to collect the username

    textInput('Username', 'Username', 'nutwition_log'),

    # create a submit button that, when clicked, updates the mainPanel() plot

    submitButton('Update View')

  ),

  mainPanel(

    # I believe this is how ggplot2 plots are to be displayed in browser - ???

    plotOutput('main_calorie_plot')

  )

))


- Dan


PS I tried using reactivePlot() also (I read that this function has been deprecated), but received the following error:

> runApp()


Listening on port 8100

Error in tryCatchList(expr, classes, parentenv, handlers) : 

  could not find function "func"
